info.name: eCommerce Storefront API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the eCommerce REST API.

### Features:
- Customer Storefront Essentials & Enums
- Full Customer Authentication (Register, Login, Token Refresh, Password Update, Profile)
- Catalog browsing (Products, Categories, Collections, Search & Autocomplete)
- Customer Shopping Cart management
- Customer Wishlist management
- Customer Shipping & Billing Address Book
- Full Checkout flow (Summary calculations, Shipping rates, Coupon validation, Order placement)
- Order tracking & Cancellation
- Payment gateway webhook simulations

### Authentication:
All protected endpoints use Laravel Sanctum Bearer tokens. Registering or logging in automatically sets the `access_token` and `refresh_token` collection variables.

variable.description: Bearer access token automatically saved after login/register
Refresh token for rotating access tokens

item.name: 03. Products
item.description: Browse, filter, and view detailed product catalog with pricing, stock, attributes, and variants.

query.description: Search term by name, SKU, or description
Sorting options: latest, price_asc, price_desc, name_asc, name_desc, popular, rating

request.description: Returns active storefront products with optional multi-attribute filters, sorting, and pagination.
Retrieves complete product details including brand, category, image gallery, variants, and attribute options.
Retrieves up to 6 related active products matching the target category or brand.

item.name: 04. Categories
item.description: Browse product categories as tree hierarchy or flat list.

query.description: Set to true for nested hierarchy tree or false for flat list

request.description: Retrieves active categories with product counts and images.
Retrieves specified category details along with subcategories and paginated product listings.

query.description: Products per page if collection type is product

item.name: 07. Cart Management
item.description: Customer shopping cart operations (Requires Bearer token).

request.description: Retrieves all items in the customer cart with calculated item subtotals, quantity, and overall cart total.
Adds a product or variant to the shopping cart. Checks stock availability and prevents over-ordering.
Updates the quantity of an existing item in the shopping cart.
Removes an item completely from customer cart.
Empties the customer shopping cart completely.

item.name: 08. Wishlist
item.description: Customer wishlist and favorites (Requires Bearer token).

request.description: Retrieves all items bookmarked in customer wishlist with product details.
Adds a product to customer wishlist if not already present.
Toggles wishlist status: adds product if missing, removes if already present.
Quick boolean check whether a specific product is saved in wishlist.

variable.description: Product ID or Wishlist Item ID to remove

request.description: Removes a specific product from customer wishlist.

item.name: 09. Customer Addresses
item.description: Manage shipping and billing addresses for fast checkout (Requires Bearer token).

request.description: Returns all saved addresses for the authenticated customer ordered with default address first.
Creates a new address in customer address book. Marking as default unsets previous default.
Retrieves a single address by its ID.
Updates address fields. Supports partial or complete updates.
Quickly sets this address as the default shipping address.
Deletes an address from the customer address book.

item.name: 10. Orders & Tracking
item.description: View customer order history, details, shipment tracking, and cancellation (Requires Bearer token).

query.description: Filter by OrderStatus enum (e.g. pending, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled)

request.description: Retrieves all orders placed by the authenticated customer with order status, tracking, and item previews.

variable.description: Order Number (e.g. ORD-20261030-0001) or Order ID

request.description: Retrieves complete order breakdown including line items, shipping address, billing address, carrier, tracking number, and payments.
Retrieves live carrier tracking status, estimated delivery dates, and checkpoints.
Cancels an eligible pending order and automatically restores reserved inventory back into stock.

item.name: 11. Checkout Flow
item.description: Order calculation, rates calculation, coupon discounts, order placement, and payment verification (Requires Bearer token).

request.description: Calculates cart or explicit items summary, applicable shipping rates, coupon discount, and totals prior to final checkout submission.
Calculates live shipping quotes across all enabled shipping providers (Flat Rate, Free Shipping, FedEx, etc.).
Validates promo or coupon code against subtotal, customer eligibility, and cart items.
